headline: Palantine Berm Boils as Passage Fight Endures
war_summary: Since the midnight edition the action has narrowed to two fronts while former busy sectors have fallen silent. Palantine Berm now carries the heaviest late traffic with four changes in two hours, nineteen in six and twenty-nine on the day, holding six Warden to one Colonial about Leiri Hermanni, Windburn Landing and The Pippeli Stones, last reported at 02:57 with two-hour losses of 317 Colonial and 263 Warden. Callahan's Passage remains close behind with three changes in two hours and fourteen on the day, now standing ten Warden holdings with none Colonial after work about The Crumbling Passage, Crumbling Post and Scath Passing to the hour of filing, on daily losses above fourteen thousand a side. Kuura Strand, the Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf record no changes in the last two hours despite fourteen, nineteen and twenty-five on the day, the latter two still divided at four-four and three-five with one unheld and last heard at 00:30. The Weathered Expanse is quiet in six hours despite thirty-five on the day at two Warden to seven Colonial, while Mooring County spends heavy casualties without fresh changes.
